sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Firing and Use of Explosive Substances at Marriages and Other Ceremonies Act 1988
sections.description:
Prohibition of firing and use of explosive substances

1[KEIYBER PAKIEITUNICHWA] (PROHIBITION OF 1 FIRING AND USE OF EXPLOSIVE
SUBSTANCES AT MARRIAGES AND OTHER CEREMONIES) ACT, 1988
1[KEIYBER
PAKIEITUNICHWA] (PROHIBITION OF 1 FIRING AND USE OF EXPLOSIVE SUBSTANCES AT
MARRIAGES AND OTHER CEREMONIES) ACT, 1988
(ACT NO. IV OF 1988)
[12th March, 1988]
An Act to prohibit firing and use of explosive substance at marriage
and other ceremonies
3. Prohibition of firing and use of explosive substances.--Firing
and use of explosive substances at the occasion of a marriage or any other
ceremony including a political reception or processing or street firing at a
public place is prohibited.

2. Definitions.--In this Act unless the context otherwise
requires...-
(a) "explosive substance" means any substances which was exploses cause fire;
(b) "firing" means firing with any type of firearms and
shooting of explosive substances.
